name: pireel
description: Edit multi-source videos and create multiple finished cuts in Pireel Studio through your agent.

defaultPrompt: Turn these source clips into three distinct short-video cuts
Clean up this talking-head and add purposeful graphics
Build a product montage with captions and a clear visual rhythm
interface.shortDescription: Create polished, editable videos with your agent
interface.longDescription: Pireel combines scenario-aware editing workflows with an authenticated MCP toolset for local media import, transcript editing, montage and multi-output variants, designed graphics, captions, themes, framing and local export. Edits remain visible and editable in Pireel Studio.
